text.tspan: From public raw reads to mapped outputs or auditable stops in one command
UniScFlow resolves sample-run metadata, recovers raw inputs and infers platform/read structure before routing to one of three endpoints.
All endpoints record scope, routing provenance, manifests and logs; mapped routes additionally emit matrices and optional BAM/HTML outputs.
The default user experience is one `--mode all` command; subcommands support inspection, debugging and resuming.
UniScFlow defines 25 named profiles: 4 proceed to automatic mapping; 21 return a documented halt when platform- or
experiment-specific inputs are required. Unsupported/non-target assays return an unsupported stop.
